basic_details.job_title: CSB Sericulture Assistant (SA) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Central Silk Board (CSB), working under the Ministry of Textiles, Government of India, is engaging 2 Sericulture Assistants (SA) on contract for one year at CSB-Central Sericultural Germplasm Resource Centre, Hosur (Tamil Nadu), at a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 21,000/- per month + HRA. Candidates with a degree in Sericulture, Agriculture Sciences/Forestry, or Biological Sciences/Biotechnology with the required add-on, aged up to 35 years, can apply online at csb-hiring.in by 16 December 2026. Selection is by personal interview only.

how_to_apply: Applications are submitted online at https://csb-hiring.in/. The last date for receipt of applications is 16 December 2026.
Give a correct and working e-mail ID in the application form, because the interview details and all further correspondence will be sent by e-mail only.
Attach self-attested copies of documents in support of the eligibility criteria.
If you have work experience, submit the relevant documents/certificates in support of it.
Complete the application by 16/12/2026. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected, and requests to add information after submission will not be entertained.
Self-attested copies of documents supporting eligibility (with the application)
Documents/certificates supporting work experience, if any (with the application)
Original certificates and identity proof (at the interview, for verification)
important_instructions: Candidates may indicate three preferred locations, but CSB decides the final posting based on merit, availability of vacancies and administrative exigencies. The number of vacancies may increase or decrease depending on the Board's requirement. CSB has full right to cancel or modify the engagement in whole or for particular post(s) without giving reasons. Candidature will be cancelled at any stage, even after joining, if information is found false, incomplete or not in line with the eligibility criteria. Documents must not be tampered, overwritten or carry correction marks. Any canvassing, directly or indirectly, will disqualify the candidature. Any corrigendum, addendum or errata will be published on www.csgrc.res.in. Legal disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of Courts at Bengaluru only. Help line e-mail: [email protected]

content_sections.heading: CSB Sericulture Assistant (SA) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Central Silk Board (CSB), Ministry of Textiles, Government of India
Contract basis for a period of one year

content_sections.heading: About Central Silk Board
content_sections.text: The Central Silk Board is a statutory body established by an Act of Parliament and working under the administrative control of the Ministry of Textiles, Government of India. According to the notice, it is the apex national organisation for the development of the silk sector, covering research and development, seed production, extension, quality certification, training, technology transfer and policy support in both the pre-cocoon and post-cocoon sectors. These posts are at its CSB-Central Sericultural Germplasm Resource Centre (CSGRC), Hosur.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The Sericulture Assistant post is under the Pre-Cocoon Sector. A candidate must hold any one of the following essential qualifications: Three years full time degree in Sericulture, OR Four years full time degree in Sericulture, OR Three years full time degree + PG Diploma in Sericulture, OR Four years full time bachelor degree in Agriculture Sciences/Forestry, OR Three years full time degree in Biological Sciences (Zoology or Botany or Biology) or Biotechnology + PG diploma in Sericulture, OR Three years full time bachelor degree in Biology Sciences (Zoology or Botany or Biology) or Biotechnology + one year experience in Sericultural project work. Desirable qualification: work experience in the field of silkworm rearing & grainage (Pre-Cocoon Sector). All essential qualifications must be from recognised universities or institutes. The prescribed qualification is the minimum, and possessing it or submitting an application does not entitle a candidate to selection. Age limit: the upper age limit is 35 years. The notice prints no minimum age and no age relaxation. Cut-off date: the age limit, qualification and other eligibility criteria are determined as on 16.12.2026. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Consolidated remuneration of Rs. 21,000/- per month, with HRA paid in addition. The engagement is purely contractual, initially for a period not exceeding one (01) year. The engagement does not confer any right for regularisation, absorption, continuation or claim for permanent/temporary appointment in CSB. The notice states that such contractual engagements do not constitute regular employment under the Government of India.

content_sections.heading: CSB Sericulture Assistant (SA) Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected individuals will not be associated with any specific project. They will assist in the work performed by Senior Technical Assistants at the CSB Institutes/Units.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSB Sericulture Assistant (SA)
content_sections.text: Applications are submitted online at https://csb-hiring.in/ . The last date for receipt of applications is 16 December 2026. Apply online through https://csb-hiring.in/ . Give a correct and working e-mail ID in the application form, because the interview details and all further correspondence will be sent by e-mail only. Attach self-attested copies of documents in support of the eligibility criteria. If you have work experience, submit the relevant documents/certificates in support of it. Complete the application by 16/12/2026. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected, and requests to add information after submission will not be entertained. Self-attested copies of documents supporting eligibility (with the application) Documents/certificates supporting work experience, if any (with the application) Original certificates and identity proof (at the interview, for verification)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: CSB will screen candidates on the basis of the applications received. Selection to the Sericulture Assistant posts will be made only on the basis of the performance of eligible candidates in a personal interview. The date, time and venue of the personal interview will be intimated to eligible candidates through e-mail only. CSB is not responsible for non-delivery or late delivery of e-mail. Candidates attend the interview at their own cost. No T.A./D.A., lodging or boarding will be given. Candidates must bring their original certificates and identity proof for verification at the interview. Failing to produce originals at document verification leads to disqualification. No communication will be made with ineligible candidates.

faq.question: Q1. How many Sericulture Assistant vacancies has CSB announced?
faq.answer: The Central Silk Board has announced 2 Sericulture Assistant (SA) posts at CSB-CSGRC Hosur, Tamilnadu; the number may increase or decrease as per the Board's requirement.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CSB Sericulture Assistant 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the CSB Sericulture Assistant post?
faq.answer: A three or four years full time degree in Sericulture, a degree with PG Diploma in Sericulture, a four years bachelor degree in Agriculture Sciences/Forestry, or a Biological Sciences/Biotechnology degree with a PG diploma in Sericulture or one year experience in Sericultural project work.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CSB Sericulture Assistant?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years, counted as on 16.12.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a CSB Sericulture Assistant?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 21,000/- per month + HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 21,000 remuneration?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states the pay as Rs. 21,000/- + HRA, so HRA is in addition to the consolidated amount.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for CSB Sericulture Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online at https://csb-hiring.in/ and attach self-attested copies of documents supporting your eligibility, before 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CSB Sericulture Assistant?
faq.answer: Selection is based only on the performance of eligible candidates in a personal interview, whose date, time and venue will be sent by e-mail.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CSB Sericulture Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual, initially for not more than one year, and gives no right to regularisation, absorption or a permanent/temporary appointment in CSB.

faq.question: Q10. Will CSB pay travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. Candidates attend the interview at their own cost, and no T.A./D.A., lodging or boarding is given.
